items.title: For long- and medium-term investors: Cycles turn, principles don’t; 5 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 29%
items.description: These are the stocks that fell the most, so they may bounce back the most if the fund flows return. They are the ones FPI money will target first. And they tend to be the businesses with great track records, the ones that have been through bad patches like this before and have come out unscathed. Yes, we are talking about large-cap stocks.

items.title: Nifty bulls reclaim 25,000 mark as FIIs step up India buying: 5 factors that will determine D-Street's fate next week
items.description: Indian equities rallied nearly 9% last week as the Nifty reclaimed 25,000 and the Sensex gained 8.82%. FIIs bought Rs 45,960 crore, while DIIs sold Rs 24,197 crore. Investors will track AI stocks, crude oil, geopolitical developments, US Treasury yields, India's October inflation data and Nifty technical levels in the coming week.

items.title: Muhurat trading 2026 today: Date, time, settlement rules, and other key things investors should know
items.description: Muhurat Trading time and settlement rules: Indian stock markets will hold a special Muhurat Trading session on November 8, from 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm, marking the beginning of Samvat 2083. The Diwali tradition symbolises prosperity, with special trading schedules across equity and commodity markets.

items.title: Diwali turned lucky for these 8 stocks! Investors' wealth more than doubled, returns soar up to 191%
items.description: A select group of 8 BSE 500 stocks delivered exceptional returns since Diwali 2025, more than doubling investors' wealth with gains of up to 191%, even as the Nifty 50 declined nearly 3%. According to ACE Equities data, 190 stocks from the index posted positive returns during the period, but only eight managed to clock gains exceeding 100%.

items.title: Muhurat Trading 2026: Which stocks to buy during special session today? Analysts list top technical picks
items.description: Investors are preparing for the Muhurat Trading session today, which marks the beginning of Samvat 2083. Stock exchanges BSE and NSE will hold the session for an hour starting at 2.20 pm. Analysts from HDFC Securities and Axis Securities have identified several stocks as top picks for this trading period. Stocks like HCL Technologies and IIFL Finance have been highlighted for their potential upside.

items.title: Bonus, stock splits & dividends: Dabur India, HUL, ONGC among 76 companies turning ex-record date this week
items.description: As many as 76 companies, including Dabur India, HUL, ONGC, NBCC, and HUDCO, have set record dates for dividends, stock splits, and bonus issues during the week of November 9-13. Markets remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, for Diwali-Balipratipada.

items.title: Playing teenpatti this Diwali? Why Warren Buffett played bridge while Charlie Munger played poker
items.description: As families gather for teenpatti this Diwali, legendary investors Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger credited card games like bridge and poker for sharpening their strategic thinking. While Buffett found mental stimulation in bridge, Munger learned how to leverage market edges through army poker games.

items.title: ​Market Trading Guide: ITC, ICICI Bank among 5 stock recommendations for Muhurat trading session
items.description: Indian equities logged one of their best weekly gains with the Nifty reclaiming 25,000 on a seven-session winning streak. Strong Q2 earnings, healthy October auto sales and firm GST collections set the stage, but Washington supplied the spark. The US midterm election verdict revived hopes of de-escalation in the Iran conflict and a softer line on tariffs.Here are five stock recommendations for Muhurat Trading:

items.title: Trading setup for the day: Gift Nifty signals positive start to Muhurat Trading
items.description: Diwali Muhurat Trading Setup: Bechmark Nifty experienced a significant increase, closing at 25,030 on Friday as markets opened positively. Investors showed optimism ahead of a special trading session on Diwali, scheduled for Sunday. Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers, contributing substantially to market growth, while domestic institutions were net sellers. The Indian rupee appreciated against the US dollar, aided by favorable market conditions.

items.title: Will Nifty's winning streak light up Muhurat trading? Check strategy and stock picks for festive gains
items.description: Muhurat Trading Stock picks 2026: Indian equities are experiencing a significant rally ahead of the Diwali Muhurat trading session on November 8. Analysts are highlighting opportunities in sectors such as banking, automobiles, pharmaceuticals, and largecap stocks. The recent surge in the Nifty marks a substantial recovery after a challenging financial year. Investors are advised to adopt a long-term investment strategy during the ceremonial trading session.

items.title: If AI unwinding pulls power stocks down, mind the difference between narrative and business: 6 stocks with upside potential of up to 30%
items.description: It is quite possible that, over the coming weeks, the narrative on the street could be that power stocks, which many had started to treat as a kind of proxy for the AI build-out, would come under pressure. But linking these stocks to global unwinding in the AI trade could be a mistake because demand for power in India depends on something far bigger and far older.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty ended lower during Muhurat Trading on November 8, snapping a six-session winning streak. Nifty slipped below 25,000 as investors booked profits. However, broader market sentiment remained positive, with 2,716 NSE stocks advancing against 736 declines.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A top consumer electricals maker for a 6.35% rise, a mid-cap private bank for a gain of 6%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty end Muhurat Trading session in red for first time in 9 years. Are the bulls losing steam?
items.description: Sensex and Nifty erased all early gains and closed in the red following the Muhurat Trading session on Sunday, marking the first time the benchmark indices ended with losses during the special Diwali session in 9 years.

items.title: Divi's Labs shares jump 8% to fresh 52-week high after Q2 profit soars 64% YoY. What brokerages say after bumper results?
items.description: Divi’s Laboratories shares surged over 8% during Muhurat Trading, hitting a 52-week high after Q2 FY27 net profit jumped 64% to ₹1,127 crore. Revenue grew 35%, while brokerages differed on valuation concerns and future growth prospects.

items.title: Tata Steel shares jump 3% after Q2 profit rises 16% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Tata Steel shares surged over 3% during Muhurat Trading after Q2 FY27 net profit rose 16% year-on-year to nearly ₹3,700 crore. Revenue increased 11.5%, while brokerages maintained Buy ratings, citing improving margins and stronger second-half performance prospects.

items.title: Lower crude, global stability to drive market growth in new Samvat: ANMI President Kamlesh Shroff
items.description: India's macroeconomic environment is poised for robust growth, projected at over seven percent, bolstering equity markets. With falling crude oil prices, the rupee may strengthen, drawing foreign investors. Retail and domestic institutional investors are actively engaging despite foreign investor withdrawal. Clarity from recent US elections is predicted to alleviate geopolitical tensions, boosting business confidence and anticipation of renewed foreign investment in Indian markets.

items.title: Indian economy to grow faster, foreign capital returning to markets: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan
items.description: India's economy is projected to experience faster growth due to strong macroeconomic fundamentals and increased foreign interest. The Managing Director of the National Stock Exchange highlighted that the country is managing fiscal pressures effectively. Domestic financial savings have significantly increased, reaching nearly USD 1.4 trillion annually. Furthermore, foreign institutional investors are showing renewed enthusiasm for Indian markets ahead of the new Samvat year.

items.title: Muhurat trading: Sensex up 320 pts, Nifty crosses 25,100; Tata Steel, Sun Pharma among top gainers
items.description: The Indian stock market opens higher in the special Muhurat trading session on Sunday, November 8, as investors welcome Samvat 2083. The Sensex rises 320 points at the opening bell, while the Nifty moves above 25,100. Tata Steel and Sun Pharma are among the top gainers. The Nifty closed Friday at 25,030.35, positioning it above key support levels ahead of the Muhurat trading session. For investors entering Samvat 2083, the recent market correction has opened up attractive opportunities in fundamentally sound companies.

items.title: Market may deliver bumper returns by next Diwali as valuations and earnings align, says Raamdeo Agrawal
items.description: Indian equities enter Samvat 2083 on a strong note, with Nifty surging 8.6% last week and reclaiming 25,000. Motilal Oswal Chairman Raamdeo Agarwal cites improving earnings, ₹45,970 crore in FPI inflows, stable currency and easing global pressures as potential drivers.

items.title: Muhurat Trading 2026: Sensex falls 29 points, Nifty below 25,000 as market snaps 6-day explosive rally on Diwali. What lies ahead in Samvat 2083?
items.description: The Indian stock market experienced sharp gains during the Muhurat Trading session on Diwali. Sensex increased by 350 points, surpassing 81,380, indicating strong investor interest. Nifty 50 rose over 80 points, crossing 23,100 as well. Tata Steel, Sun Pharma, BEL, and HDFC Bank contributed to these gains, while some stocks faced losses. Overall, the market breadth remained positive, with more advances than declines.
